test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is correct about black soil?

options.text: It covers most of the Deccan Plateau.
It is the least fertile of all soil types.
It covers most of the North Indian Gangetic Plain.
Black soils are rich in phosphorus, nitrogen.

solution:
The correct answer is** It covers most of the Deccan Plateau.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Black soil** covers most of the **Deccan Plateau**.
 
• It is also known as **Regur soil** or **cotton soil** due to its suitability for growing cotton.
 
• Black soil is rich in **calcium carbonate, magnesium, potash, and lime** but poor in nitrogen and phosphorus.
 
• This type of soil is known for its capacity to hold moisture and become sticky when wet, which helps in growing crops like cotton, cereals, oilseeds, and citrus fruits.
 
• The soil is formed from the weathering of volcanic rocks and is predominantly found in states like **Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat, Andhra Pradesh, and Tamil Nadu**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Black soil** is highly moisture-retentive and becomes very hard when dry.
 
• It is one of the most fertile soils in India and is extensively used for agriculture.
 
• The soil's color ranges from deep black to chestnut brown.
 
• Black soil is ideal for growing crops like **cotton, wheat, sorghum, and millet**.
 
• This soil type is also known for its self-ploughing nature, which means it develops cracks during dry periods, helping in natural aeration and reducing the need for mechanical ploughing.
